measured.note: Every request is written down and stopped, and the page also counts when its markup or style sheets name another site. A place at the page’s own address (a font file at /fonts/, a style sheet, a form action) is not a deviation; it is listed as not shipped with the page.

measured.title: Corner radii: every drawn box uses a radius of the Prescription
measured.note: Boxes with a fill, an edge, or a picture are compared; a radius of 0 is always allowed.

measured.note: The ratio of each text to its background by the WCAG 2.x formula. The Prescription holds no Floors yet, so no ratio is a deviation from it; the lines show texts below the usual least.

measured.title: Content: the three required texts of the Brief are on the page
measured.note: The business name, the headline, and the primary action, as the Mockup shows them, compared at each window width without regard to letter case or runs of white space. A text that is empty in the Mockup is counted as not measured.

measured.title: Width: the page is not wider than its window
measured.note: Measured at each window width; sideways scrolling is a deviation.

stillNeedsPerson: What the page looks like. The program measured colors, typefaces, corner radii, contrast, and widths; it did not look at the page.
Whether the page works with the keyboard alone, and with a screen reader.
Whether the words are right and say what the owner means.
Every craft rule of the Prescription. The check of each rule searches a style sheet for the Mockup’s own marks, so it cannot judge the style sheet of another page.
The states that the program did not open: hover, focus, open menus, and every page other than the one given.
Shadows, gradients, and images. The program did not compare them with the Prescription.
